items.title: UnitedHealth Stock Recovered Before Its Margins Did
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) stock has gained about 41% since early March, and at roughly $400 a share the market has already paid for a recovery. The easy reading is that the turnaround is finished. It is not. One half got better over those six months, the other got worse, and the price reflects the good half.

items.title: Is UnitedHealth Finally Turning the Corner After a Tough 2025?
items.summary: UNH is showing signs of recovery as medical costs improve, Optum gains momentum and 2026 earnings guidance rises.

items.title: CVS Stock Has Left Its Peers Behind. Or Has It?
items.summary: The market has crowned this healthcare giant the winner of its group, but a look at the underlying business raises the question of whether the celebration started too soon.

items.title: For 4 Years, The Villages’ Top Health Provider Allegedly Filed False Medicare Codes. The Bill Just Came Due: $541.5 Million.
items.summary: A retirement community's top health provider quietly told the government it had been overbilling Medicare for years, then filed for bankruptcy before the consequences arrived. What happened next reshaped who owns the clinics, who absorbs the loss, and what federal prosecutors are targeting next.

items.title: Johns Hopkins Health Plans taps interim CEO as it searches for successor
items.summary: Daniel Chojnowski, JHHP’s current CFO, will provide stability so that the Baltimore-area insurer can recruit full-time for its next chief executive, the company said.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Names New Medical Chief On AI Push As Valuation Debate Builds
items.summary: Humana (HUM) has drawn fresh attention after announcing that Shantanu Nundy, M.D., will become Chief Medical Officer on August 31, 2026, in a move that foregrounds technology, AI and clinical leadership.
